promptScenarios.title: Card Summary
promptScenarios.summary: Push the backend toward a single summary card.
promptScenarios.prompt: Create a concise launch-readiness summary as one card with a title, short description, and one follow-up note for the operator.
promptScenarios.instructions: Favor one canonical Card with compact copy. Avoid mixing in unrelated component families unless strictly needed.

promptScenarios.title: Badge Statuses
promptScenarios.summary: Validate short categorical output using badges.
promptScenarios.prompt: Show rollout status for dev, staging, and production environments using short badge-like labels and minimal explanatory text.
promptScenarios.instructions: Prefer Badge components for the statuses and keep layout compact.

promptScenarios.title: Button CTA
promptScenarios.summary: Validate action-oriented output with a button.
promptScenarios.prompt: Create a deployment approval panel with a short explanation and a single primary action button for the next operator step.
promptScenarios.instructions: Return a clear call-to-action and keep the rest of the layout minimal.

promptScenarios.title: List Checklist
promptScenarios.summary: Validate ordered or bulleted content rendering.
promptScenarios.prompt: Turn a new-customer onboarding flow into a compact checklist with five concrete steps and a short heading.
promptScenarios.instructions: Prefer a List as the main content vehicle. Keep each item short and explicit.

promptScenarios.title: Table Register
promptScenarios.prompt: Render a release risk register as a compact table with columns for risk, owner, severity, and mitigation.
promptScenarios.instructions: Prefer a single Table with 3 to 5 rows and stable headers.

promptScenarios.title: Grid KPIs
promptScenarios.summary: Validate multi-card layout with grid semantics.
promptScenarios.prompt: Show four KPI snapshots for revenue, margin, uptime, and NPS in a compact dashboard layout.
promptScenarios.instructions: Prefer Grid for the top-level layout and keep each KPI in its own Card.

promptScenarios.title: Container Overview
promptScenarios.summary: Validate nested grouping and layout containers.
promptScenarios.prompt: Compose a release overview with a grouped summary, one short checklist, and a row of environment indicators.
promptScenarios.instructions: Prefer Container as the primary grouping primitive. Nest child components inside it.

promptScenarios.title: Stack Briefing
promptScenarios.summary: Validate vertical sequencing of related blocks.
promptScenarios.prompt: Create an operator briefing stacked vertically with three sections: current state, blockers, and next actions.
promptScenarios.instructions: Prefer Stack for the main arrangement and keep all sections concise.

promptScenarios.title: Form Intake
promptScenarios.summary: Validate form-oriented UI with inputs and submit action.
promptScenarios.prompt: Draft a lead intake form for enterprise prospects with fields for name, company, email, urgency, and a submit action.
promptScenarios.instructions: Prefer a compact Form containing Input fields and one clear submit Button.

promptScenarios.title: Tabs By Region
promptScenarios.prompt: Compare launch readiness for Americas, EMEA, and APAC using tabs with a short summary for each region.
promptScenarios.instructions: Prefer Tabs with three panes and concise content inside each pane.

promptScenarios.title: Mixed Smoke
promptScenarios.summary: Run one broader scenario that mixes component families.
promptScenarios.prompt: Build a small operations console with a grouped overview, KPI cards, a short incident list, a status table, and one follow-up action.
promptScenarios.instructions: Keep the response compact but exercise multiple canonical component families in one render.
